note: Women-run services, per destination. Signals are shown individually and each one expires: a verification without an expiry becomes a lie the moment it stops being true. Never combine them into a score — 98% trusted tells a traveller nothing she can check.

signalTypes.label: Phone verified

signalTypes.label: Travellers served

providers.name: A photographer in Goa
